notes.title: Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and welcome to Gabriel's Auditory Playground! The game that does not rely on sight [i]at all[/i].

With the initial release there are two minigames to choose from, shoot some zombies or cook some burgers. As you know, I plan on coming in with a good few more options in the near future or expanding on the few I know work best.

I hope you enjoy the game but if you have any feedback at all, good or bad, please make sure to fill out this [url=https://forms.gle/LEGq8kRWPyzPBwcX8]survey![/url]

Enjoy!
